description: The system shall allow users to access the portal through personal credential authentication.
The user shall be authenticated and able to access the portal functionalities upon successful validation of credentials.
The system shall display a list of applications to which the user has access.
The user shall only see the applications to which they have access after logging in.
The system shall allow users to access applications from the portal.
The user shall be redirected to the main page of the selected application upon selection from the portal list.
The system shall restrict data visualization and actions (create, modify, delete) based on assigned user roles.
The system shall verify user roles and permissions to allow or deny actions and access to screens accordingly.
The system shall prevent access to data belonging to other clients.
The system shall verify the client associated with the user and only display data belonging to that client.
The system shall convert any mention of the old name to the new name.
The new name shall be displayed in any place where it is mentioned, both on screens and in data.
The system shall allow administrators to assign or revoke access to applications for users.
The system shall update the user's access data, modifying the list of applications available to the affected user upon their next login.
The new content must maintain visual coherence with the design of the old version of the application.
The design, colors, fonts, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users shall not need to ask for help from a third party to use the application.
The application must be available in several languages.
Translations must be complete and correct in both languages.
The user must be able to perform new operations without special training.
The learning time for new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a load time of less than 1 second.
Response time must not exceed 1 second in 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring its availability at any time.
The system availability must be at least 99.9%, even during moments of intensive use.
The web application must support a large number of concurrent users without degrading its performance.
The system must support a large number of concurrent users without degrading its performance.
The system must allow the creation, query, modification, and deletion of data to authorized users.
The system must have a secure authentication and permission verification mechanism to ensure that each user can only access the information and functionalities that correspond to them.
The application must manage a strict separation of data for each client.
No user can access data from other clients.
